format.block: uint32 tile id, n polylines, n vertices, n maxima; uint16 length per polyline; uint8 tip flags per polyline (bit0/bit1: start/end is a free tip, taper it); uint16 x,y,z per vertex; uint8 log10(1+delta) code per vertex; uint16 x,y,z per maximum; uint8 code per maximum; each array padded to 4 bytes
format.v3: header + float32 unit after the 4 uint32; vertex arrays replaced by uint16 x,y,z of the first vertex of each polyline, then int8 x,y,z steps (x unit) for the other vertices in order
format.thinning: whole filaments (pieces linked across tile faces) kept or dropped together: per 100 Mpc/h shell of their nearest point, densest (peak log10(1+delta) / sigma) first up to the vertex budget, all within rfull; maxima above a density floor rising with distance
